tools.name: generate_password
tools.description:
Generates a strong random password with a cryptographically secure generator.

WHEN TO USE: the user asks for a password or a random key.

HOW IT WORKS: always uses upper and lower case letters; numbers and symbols are optional. Each selected kind of character appears at least once. length: 8 to 64

tools.name: compare_timezones
tools.description:
Converts one moment across several time zones, daylight saving time included.

WHEN TO USE: "what time is it in…", scheduling a meeting across cities, checking whether a time falls at night or on another day somewhere.

HOW IT WORKS:
- zones: IANA time zone names in Area/City form — America/Sao_Paul

tools.name: data_to_chart
tools.description:
Draws a chart from a CSV table and returns it as an image.

WHEN TO USE: the user wants to see data as a chart, or needs a chart image for a document, a README, a slide or a chat.

HOW IT WORKS:
- csv: a header row, then data rows. First column: the category (or x value); the next columns: numbers.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description:
Reads a text aloud with a Microsoft neural voice (the voices of Edge's "Read aloud") and returns an MP3.

WHEN TO USE: the user wants to hear a text or needs an audio file of it — narration, audiobook, lesson, voice-over, a message read aloud.

tools.name: web_to_markdown
tools.description:
Fetches a public web page and returns its content as clean Markdown.

WHEN TO USE: you need to read a page — documentation, an article, a product page — to answer, summarize or quote it; or the user wants a page as Markdown.

HOW IT WORKS:
- url: a public http(s) address. Private networks, localhost

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.tools.ciromaciel.click" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_timezones, text_to_speech, web_to_markdown · Private data: generate_password, data_to_chart, text_to_speech, web_to_markdown · Public sink: text_to_speech · Destructive: compare_timezones, text_to_speech.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_timezones, text_to_speech, web_to_markdown · Private data: generate_password, data_to_chart, text_to_speech, web_to_markdown · Public sink: text_to_speech · Destructive: compare_timezones, text_to_speech

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
